mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,id,task_id,owner_actor_id,invocation_id,ordinal,record_version,question_version,revision,binding_digest,mode,effective_timeout,phase,request_snapshot,request_digest,created_at,foreground_due_at,answer_expires_at,retain_until,close_code,answer_id,answered_actor_id,answered_at,accepted_seq,answer_snapshot,answer_digest,answer_key,answer_request_digest,answer_source_revision,receipt_snapshot,delivery_state,delivery_step_id,retained_digests FROM user_question WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} AND id=#{request} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,id,task_id,owner_actor_id,invocation_id,ordinal,record_version,question_version,revision,binding_digest,mode,effective_timeout,phase,request_snapshot,request_digest,created_at,foreground_due_at,answer_expires_at,retain_until,close_code,answer_id,answered_actor_id,answered_at,accepted_seq,answer_snapshot,answer_digest,answer_key,answer_request_digest,answer_source_revision,receipt_snapshot,delivery_state,delivery_step_id,retained_digests FROM user_question WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} AND owner_actor_id=#{actor} AND answer_key=#{key}

SELECT tenant_id,id,task_id,owner_actor_id,invocation_id,ordinal,record_version,question_version,revision,binding_digest,mode,effective_timeout,phase,request_snapshot,request_digest,created_at,foreground_due_at,answer_expires_at,retain_until,close_code,answer_id,answered_actor_id,answered_at,accepted_seq,answer_snapshot,answer_digest,answer_key,answer_request_digest,answer_source_revision,receipt_snapshot,delivery_state,delivery_step_id,retained_digests FROM user_question WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{request}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(accepted_seq),0)+1 FROM user_question WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_question SET phase='ANSWERED',revision=revision+1,answer_id=#{answerId},answered_actor_id=#{actor},answered_at=#{answeredAt},accepted_seq=#{seq},answer_snapshot=#{answer},answer_digest=#{answerDigest},answer_key=#{key},answer_request_digest=#{requestDigest},answer_source_revision=#{sourceRevision},receipt_snapshot=#{receipt},delivery_state=#{delivery} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{request} AND revision=#{revision} AND answer_id IS NULL
